title: Magnificat quarti toni (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Magnificat quarti toni. 2 voices (Superius, Tenor), each on its own staff. Source: Fuenllana 1554 (only found in tablature). From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2004); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
